_doc: Where each character's trips start and end (docs/LUMBER_LOOP.md §3; harness/home.py): Logan Wolf's house since 2026-10-21 (before: Logan Wolf's rental room through the DTF guild house's steward). The way home is the character's own book's rune `rune` (its default rune instead when that one lands at home), which lands on `landing` (facet `facet`) inside the house; within home.HOME_R tiles of it is home. Everything a trip ends with is within reach of `landing` (live 2026-10-21): the boards and ingots go into the house's Resource Stockpile `stockpile` (harness/stockpile.py) when the home has one, else into the secure container `chest`; `forge`: the house's forge (the mining runner smelts the carried ore there before storing it, harness/loop_mining.py); the storage shelf's Restock and Resupply at the house's shelf (found by its name). `library` is the rune library trips may recall out from (harness/data/rune_libraries.json): it stands in the DTF guild house, which `library_rune` (a rune of our own book: `name`, the tile it lands on `landing`) recalls into, the guild's storage shelf 2 tiles off; then a walk to the tome. Runes of our own books recall out from home directly. `dropoff`: the hunt's loot drop-off (harness/dropoff.py, `ctl act dropoff`), every item within 2 tiles of `landing`.

dropoff._doc: harness/dropoff.py, `ctl act dropoff`: the user's Razor script 'New Drop Off' (Scripts/New Drop Off.razor, F5), step for step; entries are clilocs (1095566 Add All In Backpack, 1095568 Add All Unidentified Items From Backpack, 3006349 Restock, 3006348 Resupply). Names: the items' labels (ctl status ground_items, 2026-10-16; the same serials in the house, 2026-10-21). Then `to_chest` from the pack's top level into `chest` (user 2026-10-15: research materials and resource maps, 'chest for now, we'll buy tomes later'; resource maps by name, their graphic not seen yet; user 2026-10-20: skill mastery orbs 0x5740 are loot no step takes; user 2026-10-20: seeds, e.g. 'very common seed' 0x5736, by name for the other rarities).
